Kaun sa model kab?

Ye system 3 steps mein kaam karta hai

  1. Seekho

    R.T.C.F. framework aur model chooser. Pata chalega kya likhna hai aur kaun sa model lena hai.

  2. Copy-paste karo

    70 ready prompts. Placeholders badlo, paste karo, kaam shuru.

  3. Apna Prompt Engineer banao

    Ek baar Project setup karo. Phir rough idea do, Claude clarifying questions puchkar tumhare liye prompt banayega.

Best model: Sonnet 5.5

Reel / Short script

Write a 60-second vertical video script about [TOPIC] for [PLATFORM].
Audience: [AUDIENCE]. Goal: [SAVES / SHARES / FOLLOWS].
Structure: 3-second hook, problem, 3 quick tips or steps, payoff, call to action.
Format: table with Time, Voiceover, On-screen text. Max 150 words of voiceover.
Best model: Opus 5.5

Business idea validator

You are a pragmatic startup advisor.
Idea: [IDEA]. Location: India. Budget: [BUDGET].
Give me: (1) who exactly would pay, (2) 3 biggest risks, (3) a cheap 7-day test to validate demand, (4) what would make you say 'stop'.
Be honest. Do not just encourage me.
Best model: Haiku 5.5

Caption variations in bulk

Write 12 caption variations for this post: [POST DESCRIPTION].
Tone: [TONE]. Length: under 30 words each.
Include 4 with a question, 4 with a bold statement, 4 with a mini-story. No hashtags.

Vague prompt vs structured prompt

Vague

Write a script about SIP.

Role, audience, length, format: kuch nahi. Claude ko sab guess karna padta hai.

R.T.C.F. (Role, Task, Context, Format)

Role: You are a senior scriptwriter for Indian personal-finance Reels.
Task: Write a 60-second Reel script that explains SIP to a complete beginner.
Context: Audience is Indian salaried people aged 22-30. Tone is friendly, no jargon, one simple example in rupees.
Format: A table with columns Time, Voiceover, On-screen text. Under 150 words. End with one clear call to action.

Dono prompts khud Claude par chalao aur output ka farak dekho. Prompt jitna clear, pehla draft utna behtar.

Ye kiske liye hai, aur kiske liye nahi

Ye tumhare liye hai agar

  • Tum freelancer, creator, student ya small business owner ho.
  • Claude use karte ho (ya shuru karne wale ho) aur output generic lagta hai.
  • Repeatable system chahiye, random prompts nahi.
  • Hinglish mein samajhna aasan lagta hai.

Ye tumhare liye nahi hai agar

  • Tum guaranteed income ya result dhoondh rahe ho. Koi guarantee nahi hai.
  • Tum advanced developer ho jo API apps bana raha hai.
  • Tum video course ya live support chahte ho. Ye ek PDF hai.
  • Tum output review kiye bina use karna chahte ho. Review zaroori hai.

Sawal-jawab

Claude use karte ho par output generic aata hai?
Aksar wajah vague prompt hota hai. Is system mein tum structured prompts likhna seekhte ho (Role, Task, Context, Format), jisse output tumhare kaam ke zyada kareeb aata hai.
Prompt engineering seekhne mein bahut time lagta hai kya?
Shuruat jaldi hoti hai: 70 copy-paste prompts hain aur ek custom Prompt Engineer Project ka setup hai. Aur behtar hone ke liye 30-day practice plan hai. Kitna time lagega, ye tumhari practice par depend karta hai.
AI models mein best model kaise choose karein?
Model Selection Guide mein task-wise table aur flowchart hai. Isse samajh aata hai ki kab Haiku, Sonnet ya Opus tumhare task ke liye theek hai.
Kya ye free Claude plan par kaam karega?
Zyadatar prompts aur chapters free plan par try ho sakte hain. Claude Code, Cowork aur Claude in Chrome jaise features paid plan par hote hain. Book mein ye alag se likha hai.
